summary: Project view and PDF show plain related-record counts (Profiles by ownership type, Structures with Primary/Secondary, Grievances with status split) and per-phase breakdown; display-only, no deep links.

notes: relatedCounts() — profiles (+ ownership: owner/co_owner/renter/sharer_or_occupants/caretaker/unset), structures (+ primary/secondary), grievances totals + open/in_progress/closed
phaseBreakdown() — per active phase counts including structures_primary/secondary; optional No phase row for null phase_id
show() and pdfShow() pass relatedCounts + phaseBreakdown
Related records cards with profile ownership split + Phase breakdown table with Primary/Secondary structure columns
